theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_cs_close_of_common_center
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Y Z Q S₁ S₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R₁ R₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity R₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity R₂ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S₂ → Y - Q - S₁ = R₁.boundary → Z - Q - S₂ = R₂.boundary → ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ Y - Z - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (R₁.mass + S₁.mass) + (R₂.mass + S₂.mass)
